agent_notes: Tetra Q&A page failed TLS in WebFetch (not cited). No page states a minutes-per-feeding or frozen-food prep time. Amazon page opened but price not within the first 100k chars; used Jeffers listing.

sources.quote: Feed once or twice daily, only what they can eat within one to two minutes.

feedings_per_day.note: Ours (1 adult, 2 young) is inside the stated once-or-twice range. Tetra's own search snippet says 2-3x daily but that page was not opened, so not cited.

feeding_trip_min.note: PetMD gives only the portion rule (eat within 1-2 minutes), which is how long the fish eat, not keeper time per feeding. No duration of the chore stated.

frozen_live_food_note.note: PetMD page gives only a safety instruction on thawing (no microwave); no prep time stated.

refill_interval.suggest: up to 6 weeks (maker-style listing; depends on portions)

sources.quote: Feeding drum volume: 100 ml/3.3fl. oz for up to 6 weeks of feedings

refill_interval.note: Retailer spec text relaying the Eheim drum volume, not the maker's own page. 6 weeks is a maximum; at several feedings/day it is shorter, so 2 weeks is conservative, not wrong.

sources.quote: Most healthy aquarium fish can go three days to a week without eating.

days_fish_can_go_without_food.note: Context only (ours not used). Same page says going more than a day or two unfed is generally not recommended unless necessary.
